note: Shared source EO 4314 (Sept 25, 1925; Rules Governing Navigation of the Panama Canal; cited by EO 5065, 6128, 7813, 8068, 8417, 8715, 9227, 9228, 9515, 9563). Library of Congress scan of 35 CFR Part 4 (CFR 1938-era), which reprints the rules with source notes '[Rule 54, E.O. 4314, Sept. 25, 1925, E.O. 6128, May 10, 1933]'.
